answer_2.quote: We follow previous works  by using m_vIoU and vIoU@R for evaluation. vIoU is a hybrid metric focusing on spatial grounding precision which is weighted by the overlapping time span between temporal prediction and ground truth, defined as vIoU = , where S I and S U is intersection and union between predicted and groundtruth frame span, respectively. vIoU@R reflects the percentage of test samples whose vIoU is larger than a threshold R, e.g. R = 0.3 and R = 0.5. Lastly m_vIoU is the mean of vIoU over all test set.
